data.gender_notes: Badsah is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bada’ meaning ‘Lord’ and ‘Sah’ meaning ‘Fortune’, the name Badsah represents the one who is the ruler of fortune and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is often referred to as Badsah, the one who bestows wealth and happiness upon his devotees. The name Badsah carries the meaning “Lord of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Badsah usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed with divine guidance and prosperity.
data.etymology: Badsah belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Badsah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Badsah holds a significant place in Indian culture, symbolizing power, wealth, and prosperity. It is a revered name in Hinduism and is often associated with the god Vishnu, who is believed to provide protection and abundance to his devotees. Furthermore, in rural Indian societies, the title 'Badsah' has traditionally been bestowed upon landlords and zamindars who wielded immense authority and controlled vast stretches of land and wealth.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Badsah signifies one's innate ability to be the ruler of their own fortune and destiny. It reflects the belief that every individual has the power within them to attract and manifest abundance in their lives. Additionally, the name is a reminder to constantly seek the blessings of the divine Lord Vishnu, who is believed to be the source of all success and prosperity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Badsah signifies the supreme ruler or the all-knowing, omnipotent God who governs the universe with wisdom and justice. The name represents the divine power that guides and protects us through our life journey.

historical_references.reference: Badsah was a powerful ruler in the early medieval period of the Gurjara-Pratihara kingdom, ruling from 833 to 855 AD. He is known for his victories against the Arab Caliphs of Baghdad, expanding the Gurjara-Pratihara kingdom's territories towards the west.
Badsah was also a prominent ruler of the Chandela dynasty, reigning from around 1010 AD. He is remembered for his patronage of arts and culture, particularly in the field of temple architecture.
